_comment: Registry of tracked oils. Only pure, single-source products (no blends). 'standard_pack' is the unit each is standardised to for the 'price per unit' view. 'density_kg_per_l' converts a volume price to a mass price for the 'price per metric tonne' view.

soybean.label: Soybean (pure veg)
soybean.notes: UK 'pure vegetable oil' that is 100% soya bean oil (KTC Vegetable). Single source, NOT a rapeseed/palm blend.

palm.label: Palm
palm.notes: Solid palm frying fat, sold by weight in a 12.5kg box -- not a 20L liquid pack, so it is standardised on mass and needs no density. Comparable to the other two only in the per-tonne view; the per-pack view compares a 12.5kg box against a 20L drum, which is why it carries its own axis.
